answer: Proof of space-time mitigates Sybil attacks by requiring agents to maintain cryptographic tables layered like shale across physical drives. Identities are verified through low-latency storage audits, imposing an onyx barrier of dedicated hardware procurement costs on any attacker spawning multiple agents. Honest participants endure like a hardy juniper with minimal computational waste. A key limitation is that enterprise entities holding surplus drive arrays gain an unfair cost advantage.
